steps.en: The form asks for the driver's name, ID, address, contact and email
steps.id: Form meminta nama, ID, alamat, kontak, dan email driver

steps.en: The driver's details are checked before they can be saved
steps.id: Data driver diperiksa sebelum bisa disimpan

steps.en: The user can attach PDF, JPG or PNG supporting documents
steps.id: User bisa melampirkan dokumen pendukung PDF, JPG, atau PNG

steps.en: Some ID types must come with required documents
steps.id: Jenis ID tertentu wajib disertai dokumen

steps.en: The details and documents are saved for each notice
steps.id: Data dan dokumen disimpan untuk setiap notice
